extDescription.message: Sends downloads and videos to the Akıntı download manager for Mac: multi-connection downloads, YouTube, torrents.

popupMissing.message: The Akıntı app must be installed on your Mac and opened at least once.

popupCaptureHint.message: Hands file downloads started in the browser over to Akıntı.

optionsCaptureHint.message: Downloads of the types below go to Akıntı instead of the browser. If Akıntı can't be reached, the browser keeps the download.

optionsExtensionsHint.message: Separate with spaces or commas (e.g. zip dmg mp4).

optionsExcludedHint.message: One domain per line. Add sites that need you to be signed in (e.g. email attachments); the browser keeps downloading from them.

optionsHow1.message: Right-click a link, video or page and choose “Download with Akıntı”.

optionsHow2.message: On a page like YouTube, click the Akıntı icon in the toolbar and choose “Download this video”.

optionsHow3.message: Akıntı always shows links in its add window first; nothing downloads until you confirm.

notInstalledBody.message: Akıntı wasn't found. Install the app and open it once; the browser keeps the download.
